name: Laminate edge delamination
describes: Where a laminate's edge is exposed, moisture can reach the PVB and the interlayer can lose its bond along the edge: a narrow band of silvery bubbles or clouding. Modern PVB shows none, or small defects mostly under 3 mm deep; an obsolete PVB type showed a band up to about 12 mm deep within a few years.

depthModernPvb.source: P. Davies, R. Cadwallader (DuPont), 'Delamination issues with laminated glass - causes and prevention', Glass Processing Days, Session 16, p. 427 (the PDF is undated; the latest inspection it reports is October 2002), https://www.aisglass.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/AIS-82.pdf
depthModernPvb.note: B14-type PVB. In service (Changi Terminal 2, 1995 extension): zero or almost zero, with occasional localised patches up to 2 mm deep. After 54 months of Florida exposure with open edges (annealed laminates): 57 % of defects under 1.6 mm deep, 39 % from 1.6 to 3.1 mm, and 4 % of the exposed edge length from 3.2 to 4.7 mm. The paper's conclusion: most defects under 3.1 mm.

depthObsoletePvb.source: P. Davies, R. Cadwallader (DuPont), 'Delamination issues with laminated glass - causes and prevention', Glass Processing Days, Session 16, p. 427 (the PDF is undated; the latest inspection it reports is October 2002), https://www.aisglass.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/AIS-82.pdf
depthObsoletePvb.note: 'Type X' PVB: about 12 mm at the Sydney Opera House by 1978; about 8 mm at Changi Terminal 2 (glazed about 1991)

sunburst.text: 'Sunburst' delaminations at the edges of laminated toughened glass come from clamping during autoclaving, and optical distortion is normally evident there; they are a making defect.
sunburst.source: P. Davies, R. Cadwallader (DuPont), 'Delamination issues with laminated glass - causes and prevention', Glass Processing Days, Session 16, p. 427 (the PDF is undated; the latest inspection it reports is October 2002), https://www.aisglass.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/AIS-82.pdf

photograph: A narrow silvery or cloudy band along an exposed laminated edge.
